title: OmniPad 1.3.0 - Linux, iOS & macOS Cross-Platform Release
notes: Expanded cross-platform support: native Linux /dev/uinput virtual controller engine (Xbox 360/DualShock 4 zero-driver on Ubuntu/Steam Deck), native iOS client app (SwiftUI, NWConnection UDP, CoreHaptics, volume button bumpers), and macOS CGEvent input simulation.
